# Fonts

`onest.woff2` is Onest (the variable `wght` font, Latin letters), under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL-Onest.txt`).
It is the copy in Motif's preview kit (`skill/preview-kit/fonts/onest.woff2`).

`NotoNaskhArabic.ttf` is Noto Naskh Arabic (the variable `wght` font), under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL-NotoNaskhArabic.txt`).
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/ad2e6647e3d97ad5a8b6b5f95042f99161af5915/ofl/notonaskharabic
(`NotoNaskhArabic[wght].ttf`, renamed). The same file as `cli/test/fixtures/expo-min/assets/fonts/`.
